news.headline: A Drone That Perches Like a Bird
news.body: Engineers in the Netherlands built a flying robot that can land on a branch and hang on! It has three finger-like grippers with touch sensors, so it can feel its way onto a perch. Once it holds on, it shuts off its motors to save battery. Scientists hope drones like it can watch over forests for a long time.

news.headline: Why Egypt's Great Pyramid Survives Earthquakes
news.body: The Great Pyramid of Giza has stood for nearly 5,000 years. Scientists measured tiny vibrations inside it and found the pyramid shakes at a different speed than the ground around it, which helps keep it safe in earthquakes. Its sturdy shape and the empty chambers inside also help spread out its weight.
